'''Bloated monstrosity''' is a monster spawned after a crystal is destroyed by [[Taraket the Necromancer]] during the battle with him. While it is alive, Taraket's auto-attacks will increase in damage.

==Achievements==
* {{Achievement|Dextrous Crystal}}
* {{Achievement|Tank and Spank}}

==Trivia==
* The bloated monstrosity uses the same model as the [[hulking zombie]] who featured in the discontinued game mode: [[Dimension of the Damned]].
